description_for_human: Deterministic Odoo ERP calculators (implementation cost, ROI, TCO, sales tax, payroll, inventory maths) and Octura content lookups. No account needed.
description_for_model: Model Context Protocol server over JSON-RPC 2.0 at POST https://octurasolutions.com/mcp. Use tools/list to discover the tools and tools/call to run one. Calculators are pure functions: same inputs, same outputs, no model in the loop. Every input has a default, so calling with {} returns a baseline. Results echo the normalized input actually used next to the result so numbers can be checked. Content tools (ask_octura, compare_odoo_vs, find_odoo_apps_for, get_odoo_pricing, get_partner_profile) return Octura pages, comparisons, app recommendations and pricing to cite. All tools are read-only. Cost models carry regional assumptions and are estimates, not quotes; tax and payroll figures are best-effort and not filing advice.
